sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 25.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 13000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 13000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Prohibits Unison for 40 seconds.
Only [Leader] Eren can be used as Unlocking Potential material
